author: calvin
title: Commentaries on the Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Romans
edition: Calvin Translation Society, tr. and ed. John Owen, Edinburgh, 1849
translation: Translated and edited by the Rev. John Owen for the Calvin Translation Society (1849)

rights.worldwide: to confirm: death dates of every author, translator and editor named (life + 70 years); John Owen, the translator, died in 1867

notes: Romans 1–16 are CCEL calcom38 chapters v–xx. Every comment paragraph is kept, in the order printed: each of Calvin's lemmas (the verse number or the italic words he comments on) opens an entry, with the paragraphs after it; a lemma's comment longer than about 350 words goes on in the next entry, and a paragraph cut between entries is marked with ' ...'. An entry is placed on the verse number Calvin prints, or else on the verse CCEL's Commentary mark puts it under; CCEL puts a few lemmas under the verse before the one they quote (the lemma 'Ye are the called of Jesus Christ', Romans 1:6, sits under 1:5). The Latin and English text Calvin prints before each section, and the translator's footnotes, are left out. Calvin's comment on the doxology (Romans 16:25-27, from 'The Epistle closes, as we see') has no lemma and CCEL leaves it under 16:21; it is on 16:25-27, added once the Open Word Bible had the verses (it took them from the Nestle 1904 text, jdegreef/open-word-bible#644).
